Package com.example.thevms.model

Class Entrant

java.lang.Object
com.example.thevms.model.Entrant
Direct Known Subclasses:
Organizer
public class Entrant extends Object
Represents an entrant in an event. An entrant can register for events, update their profile, and receive notifications.
